title: Dean Dulchinos Quoted in PEI PERE: Debt Fund Managers Brace for Year-End Lending Slowdown

body_markdown:
As interest rate volatility continues to shape the commercial real estate lending landscape, borrowers are increasingly looking to alternative financing solutions to maintain flexibility. ORIX USA’s Group Head of Real Estate Debt,[Dean Dulchinos](https://www.orix.com/people/dean-dulchinos/) , recently spoke with *PEI PERE* to share his perspectives on the growing demand for shorter-term bridge financing as borrowers seek greater flexibility in the current market environment.


Highlights from Dean:


- Dean Dulchinos, group head of real estate debt at ORIX USA, said the firm’s bridge loan volume has stepped up. “Some borrowers who were considering a longer-term, fixed-rate loan have shifted their focus to shorter-term, bridge loans to bridge through what may be a period of higher rates before they can reset into a fixed-rate product at lower rates,” Dulchinos said. “The rate increases we have been seeing recently have only augmented that dealflow because a lot of investors on the equity side of the business do not want to lock in long-term, fixed-rate loans.”
